reason: The hypothesis synthesizes three distinct lines of evidence—nanocrystalline RHEA irradiation tolerance (P1, P2, P16), grain-boundary He bubble coalescence in nanocrystalline W (P6, P7, P17), and coherent oxide dispersoid benefits in ODS W (P8, P31)—and combines them with a specific compositional adjustment (V→Mo) motivated by He bubble size data (P34, P35, P36) into a single integrated proposal that no passage states or suggests. It links these through a mechanism (dispersoids as defect sinks and grain-boundary pins to moderate bubble coalescence while preserving defect recombination) that none of the passages articulates, and it targets a conflict between defect recombination and grain-boundary degradation that the literature identifies but does not resolve.
